title: Practice 2: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Закройте окна, а то комары ___ (налететь / налетать).
exercises.why: Я налетал 2500 часов на Боинге 737. — I had 2500 flight hours in Boeing 737. — в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc.. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Close the windows. Otherwise, mosquitoes will get in.
exercises.context: Я налетал 2500 часов на Боинге 737. — I had 2500 flight hours in Boeing 737. — в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc..

exercises.q: Том ___ (наводить / навести) порядок у себя в комнате.
exercises.why: **навести́** — **наводи́ть** — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply. **наползти́** — **наполза́ть** — (colloquial) to crawl .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with на (na, + accusative) ‘onto something’]. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Tom is tidying up his room.
exercises.context: навести́** — **наводи́ть — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply.

exercises.q: Мэри ___ (нанести / наносить) на лицо увлажняющий крем.
exercises.why: **нанести́** — **наноси́ть** — to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.); to mark (on); to draw (e.g. onto a map). **навести́** — **наводи́ть** — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply. **наползти́** — **наполза́ть** — (colloquial) to crawl .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with на (na, + accusative) ‘onto something’]. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Mary applied moisturizing cream to her face.
exercises.context: нанести́** — **наноси́ть — to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.); to mark (on); to draw (e.g. onto a map).

exercises.q: One king after another succeeded to the throne during those few years.
exercises.why: Temporal and resultative prefixes, from the same table: по- — Beginning of unidirectional movement, with unidirectional verb of motion: Я пошла в университет. — I went to the university. Other: 1. Intention to carry out a movement in the future: Зимой я собираюсь поехать во Флориду. — In the winter I plan to go to Florida. 2. Approximate location of the agent at moment of speech: Где папа? Он пошёл на работу. — Where's Dad? He went to (is at) work. по- — Slow and measured multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion: Она задумчиво походила по квартире и наконец решила уйти. — She walked around the apartment pensively and finally decided to leave. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.ru: В эти несколько лет один король ___ на престол за другим.
exercises.context: Temporal and resultative prefixes, from the same table: по- — Beginning of unidirectional movement, with unidirectional verb of motion: Я пошла в университет. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.q: Вертолёт может ___ (взлетать / взлететь) и садиться вертикально.

exercises.prompt: A helicopter is able to take off and land straight up and down.
exercises.context: взлете́ть** — **взлета́ть — to fly up, to soar, to take off, to take wing; (figurative) to zoom.
